title: Keyhoe: Air Force tracked two unknown satellites in 1953

tellings.quote: Keyhoe states something astonishing, that the Air Force was tracking two unknown artificial satellites 400 and 600 miles up in low Earth orbit.

plain: In 1953 the Air Force was tracking two unknown artificial satellites circling Earth, one 400 miles up and the other 600 miles up. That is what the UFO writer Donald Keyhoe states, according to Michels, who repeats it from Keyhoe without naming the work. If true, made objects of unknown origin were orbiting Earth at the time.
